title: Me using Claude Opus to rename a file
title_candidates: The most powerful AI in the world, used to rename a single file
What Claude actually does when you give it the world's simplest task
Claude Opus 4.8 can code entire apps. Someone asked it to rename a file.
What a billion dollar AI model does when you give it one job
The AI built to solve the hardest problems in science, given a filename to change
caption:
Claude Opus 4.8 can write full software from scratch and solve problems that stump human experts. Someone used it here to rename a file.

Anthropic, the company behind Claude, was last valued at over $60 billion. The task shown in this clip would have taken about two seconds to do by hand.

Claude Opus 4.8 was built for some of the hardest reasoning problems in science and engineering. The most watched clip of it involves a filename.
